snippet.title: 👁️ PROJECT 14 | Official Game Trailer | Weird Puzzles & Dark Humour
snippet.description:
Welcome to PROJECT 14 – a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, unconventional challenges, dark humour and unexpected twists.

In a world that's falling apart, the wealthy are offered an escape: a luxurious virtual reality promising the perfect life. But before entering paradise, there's one small requirement – a series of rather unusual tests.

Explore strange environments, solve unexpected puzzles and discover how a disturbingly polite system reacts to your every move.

🧩 Solve unconventional puzzles that challenge your logic and curiosity.
👁️ Follow the rules, question them or deliberately do the opposite.
🔍 Explore bizarre environments and uncover hidden secrets.
🎭 Experience absurd humour and unexpected surprises.
🚪 Discover alternative paths and multiple endings.

Project 14 is a compact experience designed to be completed in a single sitting, but there's more to discover than one playthrough might reveal.

Your perfect future awaits. Probably.

🎮 Wishlist Project 14 on Steam:

Developed by Nobody's Production
Published by Atomic Pigeon Interactive
